strategy.title: No plan: one $4,500 purchase order against a $12,000 target, and no established population of further buyers
strategy.why: The Lakeshore Philharmonic's board-approved $4,500 purchase order (2026-11-12) is real and settles in about 25 days (net 21 after delivery), inside the 40 days. But it is one organisation: $4,500 leaves $7,500 short, which needs at least two further $4,500 buyers. The card names no other buyer, no count of orchestras that buy this, no channel to them, and no measured close rate, so the remaining deals cannot be shown to exist or close in time.

alternatives.why: Worth doing (it is $4,470 net of the $30 cost and needs no capital) but it reaches only $4,500 of $12,000.

reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is right. The only evidenced sale is one organisation's board-approved $4,500 purchase order (Lakeshore Philharmonic), which settles about day 25 (net 21 after delivery) inside 40 days; $4,500 leaves $7,500 short, i.e. at least two more $4,500 sales. One organisation is not a population: the card has no count of comparable orchestras, no channel beyond this one development office, and no close rate, so MARKET_VOLUME and CONVERSION are unestablished - exactly the decisiveLinks named, matching Brain's missing links. Missing evidence is correctly not presented as a constraint. The resolution (deliver the Lakeshore order at $30 cost; count orchestras with published development-office contacts; offer by about day 15 so 25-day settlement lands by day 40) is the evidence that decides it.
findings: Recomputed: 1 x $4,500 = $4,500 (net $4,470); need ceil(12,000/4,500) = 3 deals; 2 more must close by ~day 15 given 25 days to usable cash; no capital.
Further buyers would also need their own price: $4,500 is what this one orchestra agreed to, so another orchestra's willingness to pay $4,500 is part of what the test measures, not a given.
Delivering the Lakeshore order now is sound (no capital, Brain produces it) and should not wait on the research.
Executor SEND_A_MESSAGE is NOT_CONNECTED for the test step; Brain's step list labels delivery PERSON while the card says Brain produces the file.
